sources.evidence: PPC's current 2026 SENS announcements identify the listed legal entity as PPC Ltd, registration number 1892/000667/06, and report its active cement manufacturing operations in Zimbabwe and the South Africa & Botswana business.

Ohorongo Cement's current official website identifies Ohorongo Cement (Pty) Ltd as a Namibian cement manufacturer owning a modern cement plant and producing more than one million tonnes of cement annually.
CIMERWA's 2024-2025 annual report identifies CIMERWA Plc as Rwanda's integrated cement manufacturer and lists its Bugarama production plant and current capacity.

Hima Cement's current official site identifies Hima Cement Limited, its Uganda cement-product portfolio, and current manufacturing operations; its company history states that it became part of Sarrai Group in 2024.
